text: Great! you want to give me a little tutorial on how it all works
resolution: Wrote the user a full tutorial of the road system as it stands after this session: drawing strokes (brush/Enter/rail cross-section), network connection gestures (endpoint snap, mid-span split, merge gesture, auto junctions+crosswalks), what stamping does (tiles+undercoat, analytic ribbon look, NEW grade-mode earthworks), traffic control placement semantics (12m junction attach, facing governs the approach, stop-sign full stop vs lamp-synced signal waits), per-stroke speed limits (strictest-along-route, clamp down only), the workbench 3x3 floor cell painter, and the 0.5m nav bake with the 64m window caveat — closing with what's NOT visible yet (no NPC driver consumes the gates/limits; that's the next slice). Documentation-only response, no code changed.
